description: Implementation of the DisplayVkAndroid class methods for Vulkan on Android, including initialization, surface creation, configuration generation, and validation functions.

classes.name: DisplayVkAndroid
classes.description: Class implementing Vulkan display functionalities for Android, including initialization, surface creation, and configuration support.

methods.name: DisplayVkAndroid::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Vulkan Android display and logs version and renderer info.

methods.name: DisplayVkAndroid::isValidNativeWindow
methods.description: Checks if the provided native window is valid based on its format.

methods.name: DisplayVkAndroid::createWindowSurfaceVk
methods.description: Creates a window surface for Vulkan rendering on Android.

methods.name: DisplayVkAndroid::generateConfigs
methods.description: Generates display configurations with specific color formats.

methods.name: DisplayVkAndroid::checkConfigSupport
methods.description: Checks support for a given configuration (currently always returns true).

methods.name: DisplayVkAndroid::validateImageClientBuffer
methods.description: Validates if a client buffer is a valid hardware buffer for Android.

methods.name: DisplayVkAndroid::createExternalImageSibling
methods.description: Creates an external image sibling for Android native buffers.

methods.name: DisplayVkAndroid::getWSIExtension
methods.description: Returns the Vulkan WSI extension name for Android.
